{{incomplete|needs=Disc divisions}} The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the twenty-second season of {{aniseries|PTS}}, [[S22|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends]], in {{pmin|Australia}} and {{pmin|New Zealand}} ({{wp|DVD region code|DVD Region 4}}). ==Partial collections== Two Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends Collections were released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in 2019 and 2020, containing the whole season between them. ===Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends - Collection 1=== [[File:Sun and Moon Ultra Legends Collection 1.png|thumb|Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon—Ultra Legends - Collection 1]] Pokémon the Series: Sun & Moon – Ultra Legends - Collection 1 was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on December 4, 2019 and in New Zealand on December 11, 2019. It contains four discs with 24 episodes across them combined. The Journey Continues!]]'' |} ==Season 22 disc set== [[File:Sun and Moon Ultra Legends disc set Region 4.png|thumb|DigiPack cover art]] The Season 22 DigiPack disc set was released by {{wp|Beyond Home Entertainment}} in Australia on April 1, 2020 and in New Zealand on May 13, 2020. It contains eight discs with 48 episodes across them combined. Its catalogue number is BHE8350. This is the last Pokémon DVD in Australia released by Beyond, due to their exit from the physical home media industry in August 2020. ===Contents=== Each disc features artwork of one specific Pokémon on the disc itself. {| class="roundtable" style="margin:auto; text-align:center; background: #{{colorschemelight|Alola}}; border: 3px solid #{{colorschemedark|Alola}}" !
